contracts.name: node_coding_agent_fsm_reducer
contracts.description: Pure coding-agent FSM reducer. Folds one workflow event (prior FSM state + event) into the next ModelCodingAgentFsmState and materializes the coding-agent correlation-trace projection. Owns the IDLE -> VALIDATING -> INVOKING -> CAPTURING -> terminal sequence, the retry policy (workspace-write invocations are never auto-retried, a duplicate correlation_id never re-runs, read-only invocations retry up to a bounded count), and the N-failure circuit breaker that trips to FAILED. Pure fold — no events, no intents over the bus, no I/O; the orchestrator publishes transition commands. Replay recomputes state + projection but the reducer issues no live intent, so replay can never cause a subprocess.
